skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply strategic analysis tools and models.
Understand and apply strategic decision-making processes.
Understand and apply global business strategies.
Understand and apply strategy implementation processes.
Understand and apply strategy evaluation and adjustment methods.
Apply critical thinking to solve strategic business problems.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and discussions.
Present and defend strategic analysis and decisions effectively.
Conduct research and analyze data to support strategic decisions.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.

prerequisite_courses: Quản trị chiến lược/ Quản trị chiến lược 1
